```python
def solution():
    # Define variables
    principal = 5_000_000
    annual_interest_rate = 0.058
    loan_term_years = 10

    # Calculate monthly interest rate and total number of payments
    monthly_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate / 12
    total_payments = loan_term_years * 12

    # Calculate the fixed monthly mortgage repayment
    monthly_payment = (
        principal * monthly_interest_rate
        / (1 - (1 + monthly_interest_rate) ** -total_payments)
    )

    # Return the initial repayment at the end of this month
    return round(monthly_payment, 3)
```
